declared_scope: The v0.12 parent stack plus a single reversible sysctl: kernel.sched_migration_cost_ns=5000000 (channel: sustained). Autonomously proposed; one knob added, nothing removed.
hypothesis: Raising sched_migration_cost_ns (0.5ms->5ms) makes the scheduler less eager to migrate warm inference threads across cores, which can help sustained tok/s and cold-start. Single-stream sustained is near its noise floor, so treat a small move as inconclusive.
rollback_method: Restores the prior kernel.sched_migration_cost_ns value captured at apply time, then delegates the rest of the revert to the v0.12 preset undo; harness reverts at run end.
